Initial release of daily-ai-briefing skill defining strict quality standards and workflow for daily AI progress reports:

- Establishes non-negotiable red-line rules for fact-checking, source validation, and time sensitivity (e.g., 14-day limit, whitelist enforcement).
- Details multi-step execution procedure: historical deduplication, prioritized source scanning, focused web search, rigorous information curation, and structured output.
- Specifies reporting template and classification into three core sections: technical breakthroughs, open-source highlights, and key industry news.
- Includes comprehensive self-checklist for each entry to enforce accuracy, completeness, and objectivity.
- Outlines clear fallback and output rules to ensure consistent, high-quality daily AI briefings.
